title: Consecration of the Priests

questions.question: What animals were brought for the consecration of the priests?
options: One bull and two rams without blemish
questions.correctAnswer: One bull and two rams without blemish
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:1 (ESV): "Take one bull of the herd and two rams without blemish."

questions.question: Where were Aaron and his sons to be consecrated?
options: At the entrance of the tent of meeting
questions.correctAnswer: At the entrance of the tent of meeting
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:4 (ESV): "You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting."

questions.question: What was done to Aaron and his sons first?
What was poured on Aaron's head?
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:7 (ESV): "You shall take the anointing oil and pour it on his head and anoint him."

questions.question: How many days did the consecration ceremony last?
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:35 (ESV): "Seven days you shall ordain them."

questions.question: What daily sacrifice was to be offered on the altar?
options: Two lambs a day, one in the morning and one at twilight
questions.correctAnswer: Two lambs a day, one in the morning and one at twilight
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:38-39 (ESV): "Two lambs a year old day by day regularly. One lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight."

questions.question: Where was blood applied during the consecration?
options: On the right ear, thumb, and big toe of Aaron and his sons
questions.correctAnswer: On the right ear, thumb, and big toe of Aaron and his sons
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:20 (ESV): "Take some of its blood and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron... and on the thumbs of their right hands and on the great toes of their right feet."

questions.question: What was the bull offered as?
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:14 (ESV): "But the flesh of the bull and its skin and its dung you shall burn... It is a sin offering."

questions.question: What did Aaron and his sons lay their hands on before it was slaughtered?
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:10 (ESV): "Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull."

questions.question: What was waved before the Lord as a wave offering?
options: The breast of the ram of ordination
questions.correctAnswer: The breast of the ram of ordination
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:26 (ESV): "You shall take the breast of the ram of Aaron's ordination and wave it for a wave offering before the Lord."

questions.question: What great promise did God make regarding the tabernacle?
options: I will dwell among the people of Israel and will be their God
questions.correctAnswer: I will dwell among the people of Israel and will be their God
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:45 (ESV): "I will dwell among the people of Israel and will be their God."

questions.question: What was the "ram of ordination" also called?
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:22 (ESV): "You shall also take the fat from the ram... the ram of ordination."

questions.question: What was sprinkled on Aaron and his garments?
options: Blood from the altar and anointing oil
questions.correctAnswer: Blood from the altar and anointing oil
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:21 (ESV): "Take some of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments."

questions.question: What was the penalty if anyone other than the priests ate the consecration meat?
options: It must not be eaten because it is holy
questions.correctAnswer: It must not be eaten because it is holy
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:33 (ESV): "An outsider shall not eat of them, because they are holy."

questions.question: What would God consecrate by His glory?
options: The tent of meeting, the altar, Aaron and his sons
questions.correctAnswer: The tent of meeting, the altar, Aaron and his sons
questions.explanation: Exodus 29:44 (ESV): "I will consecrate the tent of meeting and the altar. Aaron also and his sons I will consecrate to serve me as priests."

key_verse_text: I will dwell among the people of Israel and will be their God. And they shall know that I am the Lord their God.
